concerns.location: tasks.md:Completed work (T015/T016) + Phases 1–3 vs contracts/flexibility_metric.schema.yaml + data-model.md:Data Flow step 4
concerns.text: The FlexibilityMetric contract lists `null_flexibility_mean` and `excess_flexibility` as REQUIRED fields and data-model step 4 says dynamics.py generates the phase-randomized null model, but no task anywhere — preserved T015/T016 or new T101–T108 — implements the null model or produces these fields. The implementer cannot satisfy the contract. Add a task or drop the fields from the contract.

T102's `sensitivity_summary.csv` specifies only `window_length`, `correlation`, `empirical_p_value`, but the sensitivity contract requires `p_value`, `permutation_p_value`, and `n_samples` (and names the column `correlation_coefficient`). The produced table would fail contract validation; no task covers emitting the schema-conformant table.

concerns.location: tasks.md:T102 deliverable vs spec.md:US-3 acceptance scenario 1
concerns.text: US-3 scenario 1 requires 'an empirical p-value is written to `permutation_results.csv`', but T102 defines that file as one row per shuffle with only `shuffle_id` and `correlation` columns, placing the p-value in `regression_summary.csv` instead. No task writes the p-value into permutation_results.csv as the spec acceptance scenario demands.

The RegressionResult contract requires `model_id`, `ci_lower`, `ci_upper`, and `n_samples` fields, but no task (T043 preserved or T102/T103) covers computing the 95% CI bounds for the flexibility coefficient or emitting the full schema-conformant result record; T103 only records r, p, ΔR², and permutation p-value.

Data model specifies preprocessed fMRI at `data/processed/fmri_clean/{id}.nii.gz` and a final-metrics file `data/interim/results.csv`; tasks write `data/processed/{subject_id}_preprocessed.nii.gz` and `data/interim/regression_summary.csv`, which is absent from the data model's file schema. No task reconciles or produces the data-model-declared paths.
